source: Physics MCQ Test OPTIMIZED — 2. Formula Cheat Sheet, pages 7-7 [Physics_MCQ_Test_OPTIMIZED.md]
textbookText: **Measurements:** relative error = (|Δm|/mean)×100% · Planck's h ≡ angular momentum dims [ML²T⁻¹] · G dims [M⁻¹L³T⁻²] · vernier LC = 0.01 cm **Vectors:** R = √(A²+B²+2AB cosθ) · A·B = AB cosθ (scalar) · A×B = AB sinθ nₑ (vector) · |A+B|=|A−B| ⇒ θ=90° · direction cosines of space diagonal = 1/√3 each **Heat:** Q = mcΔθ · Q = mL · 1 cal ≈ 4.2 J · F = (9/5)C + 32 · −40°: C = F · clinical range 35–42°C · triple point of water 273.16 K **Mirrors:** 1/v + 1/u = 1/f · f = R/2 · m = −v/u = h′/h · object at C → image at C (real, same size) · object between P and F → virtual, erect, magnified (shaving mirror) · convex = virtual/erect/diminished/always, widest FOV (car mirrors).
